name: Tapioca DAO
rootCause: Another day, another private key theft, another protocol rekt. Tapioca DAO on Arbitrum suffers a roughly $4.4 million loss in a private key compromise. Some funds have been recovered, though the full extent of the damage remains to be seen.

descriptions.text: Another day, another private key theft, another protocol rekt. Tapioca DAO on Arbitrum suffers a roughly $4.4 million loss in a private key compromise. Some funds have been recovered, though the full extent of the damage remains to be seen.

Tapioca DAO experienced a significant security breach, with attackers obtaining relevant private keys through social engineering attacks and stealing approximately $4.7 million in cryptocurrency. On October 25, Tapioca DAO released an incident analysis report stating that the security breach occurred because attackers successfully compromised the private keys of a core contributor responsible for smart contract development. SEAL911 confirmed that the attackers were part of a North Korean hacking group that used a contagious interview attack method to inject malware onto the contributor's computer, thereby gaining access to the private keys of their address to carry out the theft.

On October 18, 2024, Tapioca DAO on Arbitrum suffered a $4.65M loss after an attacker gained control of a lead developer’s private key through a malware-laced fake job interview. The attacker used these credentials to mint USDO, steal TAP tokens, drain protocol liquidity, and bridge assets out. While roughly $2.65M was later recovered, the breach exposed critical failures in admin key management and operational security. Compromise of a core developer’s private key via social engineering and malware allowed the attacker to seize single-signer admin controls, mint stablecoins, and extract protocol-owned assets.
